subject: Re: Staging dataset exchange + destruction timeline (MAP)
messages:
From: Jordan Levine <jordan.levine@acme-analytics.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: security@acme-analytics.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Staging dataset exchange and retention request

Hi Karthik / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the model latency looks promising. Per our evaluation plan, we're ready to hand over a scoped subset of ACME's anonymized user prompts and a small labeled holdout for accuracy verification. Attached: acme-assessment-pack-v2.tar.gz (6.2 MB) — includes README and access manifest.

Ask from our side: we need Redwood to confirm the staging environment, a plan for short-term retention (we propose deletion after evaluation), and a MAP with clear milestones so procurement can tie the vendor approval to a timeline.

High-level proposal from ACME:
- Transfer via pre-signed S3 link to Redwood staging (we can upload once you confirm bucket / IAM)
- Access for up to 3 Redwood engineers for up to 90 days
- Audit evidence (checksum + access log) at handoff and final deletion confirmation

Could you confirm the staging access flow, proposed retention window, and whether Redwood can accept the dataset under a limited-use evaluation covenant?

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Levine
Head of ML Infrastructure, ACME Analytics

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Jordan Levine <jordan.levine@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staging dataset exchange and retention request

Jordan — thanks for the package and clear asks. Short answer: yes, we can support the flow you outlined with the following constraints and MAP milestones (suggested):

1) Staging transfer: Redwood will provide a limited-scope S3 staging bucket (pre-signed PUT) and an engineer contact (Dev Patel) to validate upload. We will accept only the file manifest you provided; no additional data ingestion allowed.

2) Access & roles: up to 3 named Redwood users. Laura will act as internal approver for access. All activity will be logged; we will share an access log snapshot at milestone close.

3) Retention & destruction: Redwood proposes 60 days retention by default for evaluation assets. At deletion we will provide a destruction report (S3 lifecycle + md5 checksums). If ACME requires 90 days, we can accommodate with an SLA amendment in the MAP (signed).

4) Usage constraints: evaluation-only (no redistribution, no training, no external benchmarking). Results summary may be shared back to ACME product owners but raw assets are restricted per the attached MAP draft (REDWOOD-MAP-draft-ACME.docx).

5) Timeline (MAP milestones):
  - Day 0 (T+0): Pre-signed upload link issued by Redwood (we will email bucket + PUT URL).
  - T+1–T+5: Ingest validation and sample checks (Dev Patel).
  - T+6–T+30: Evaluation run window (ACME to provide evaluation scripts; Redwood to run inference per mutual action plan).
  - T+60 (or T+90 if amended): Scheduled deletion and delivery of destruction report.

Next steps I suggest:
- Laura to confirm legal/commercial fallback on retention window (60 vs 90).
- We share the MAP doc for signature (DocuSign).
- ACME to upload to the presigned link we will generate.

I've attached a draft MAP and a small prompt pack we use for sanity checks. Laura — do you want me to flag anything for procurement here?

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staging dataset exchange and retention request

Jordan — appreciate the clear proposal. A couple of procurement / legal notes from our side:

- Retention: default 60 days for evaluation is standard for Redwood. If ACME needs 90, we can sign that into the MAP but it will require a brief procurement approval (timeline + liability language).

- Controlled use: we will explicitly prohibit training and redistribution. We will include an audit clause requiring Redwood to provide access logs and deletion proof (S3 lifecycle + md5) as you requested.

- Data handling evidence: please share the manifest and sample rows (sanitized) so our ingest validation can run locally before transfer. If you prefer, we can accept a subset upload first for validation.

Commercially, Marissa — can we align on a soft close target? I propose we aim to have MAP signed and dataset in staging by 2026-07-02 so the evaluation can complete by 2026-08-01. That fits ACME's product roadmap and keeps close within this quarter.

Marissa: please prepare the MAP signature request and confirm pricing guardrails (evaluation credits / short-term discount).

Laura Bennett
Director, Cloud Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -07:00

Jordan — great to see momentum. Quick commercial notes and next steps: 

- I created a DocuSign envelope for the MAP with a retention toggle (60/90 days) and the limited-use evaluation covenant. Link: https://na.docusign.com/REDACTED-signature-request
- ACME evaluation credits: we're offering 150k token credits for the initial evaluation window (applies to inference only).
- Attachment: redwood-eval-promptpack-v1.zip (small sanity prompt set we run on first ingest).

Ask: please confirm which retention you prefer ("60-days" or "90-days") and that ACME's security team will accept the described audit artifacts. Once you sign the MAP we will issue the presigned upload link and target T+1 ingest validation.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
